maddeler.e:
أستنبئ (form X)
# أَسْتَنْبِئُ (ʔastanbiʔu) /ʔas.tan.bi.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# أَسْتَنْبِئَ (ʔastanbiʔa) /ʔas.tan.bi.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# أَسْتَنْبِئْ (ʔastanbiʔ) /ʔas.tan.biʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
